dogecoin.text: Dogecoin’s price rose 3%, with a $60M drop in open interest signaling short traders exiting, often leading to more gains. If DOGE breaks $0.30, further upside is likely, but a drop below $0.28 could trigger a pullback to $0.23.
This boosted investor interest, pushing Dogecoin’s market cap to $41.4 billion.

Dogecoin’s price rose 3% on Friday, bringing its weekly gain to 17%, fueled by speculation around ETF filings. The SEC’s acknowledgment of Grayscale’s Dogecoin and XRP ETF applications signals a shift in regulatory stance under President Trump.
